problem_type: Derived storyboard projections must respect durable canvas write ownership
symptom: Original storyboard receipt preparation race integration test returns capability_receipt_unresolved instead of capability_target_stale.
direct_cause: Adding a design updates the canonical store then synchronously creates its shot table while another proposal owns the durable receipt. addNode throws AbortError before target revalidation.
class_root: Derived canvas projection is treated as an independent synchronous user write rather than following its owner and current canvas lifetime.
affected_population: Design create, duplicate and explicit plan edits during receipt preparation or commit
internal_only_reason: Internal store and durable receipt composition; no external API or framework change.
invariants: Same-owner projection stays synchronous; foreign derived projection waits without interrupting durable receipt.
Deferred projection reads current design and canvas and never crosses undo journal generation.
Existing admission error codes remain unchanged.
generality_proof: Every explicit design write enters the composition callback; table creation and shot updates share the same ownership-aware scheduler and live reads.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Run same-owner derived writes synchronously and defer foreign writes through the existing settlement queue.
Bind deferred projection to current canvas generation and reread the source.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Create and duplicate invoke projectPlan after canonical source update.
Explicit edits use the same projectPlan composition callback.

recurrence.reason: Any explicit edit while a durable receipt is pending reaches this race.
same_class_scan: rg projectPlan in workbenchDocumentSlice.ts checked creation, duplication, replacement and patch.
rg whenCanvasWriteBoundarySettled checked factBridge and model-default derived updates.

prevention.invariant: Foreign derived writes wait for ownership settlement, then validate lifetime and reread current state.
prevention.failure_mode: Stale generation or deleted source produces no canvas mutation; admission rejects stale approval normally.
prevention.strategy: Reuse existing settledWaiters, preserve current-owner context and recheck ownership after each wait.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace unconditional synchronous projection with one ownership-aware path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency version controls internal transaction ownership.

migration: No persisted schema change; existing designs are reread from their canonical store.
residual_risks: Linux performance verification is separate from this receipt invariant.

invariant_owner_layer.why: All explicit plan projections converge here before touching the canvas.
